description: Contractor directory record stored in Netlify Blobs. Sample fixtures are example data and are not live contractors.

fields.contractor_id: Stable id, lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
fields.example: True on sample fixtures. Example rows are not suggested for a live lead.
fields.data_notice: Fixtures must say they are example data.
fields.active: False removes the contractor from matching.
fields.paused: True removes the contractor from matching.
fields.license: License record: authority, number, status, expiration, the date it was checked, and the lookup URL.
fields.insurance: General liability expiration. Workers comp expiration is optional.
fields.brand_certs: Brand program listings with the date checked and an evidence URL. Not an endorsement.
fields.service_zip3s: Three-digit ZIP prefixes this contractor serves.
fields.equipment_tags: Equipment, brand, furnace skill, and Bosch series tags used for matching. Furnace skill tags include gas_combustion, propane, oil, electrical, any_hvac, manufactured_home, hydronic_hydro_air, and replacement.
